parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is a small lever or handle made of stainless steel, typically cylindrical in shape, attached to the faucet body.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting the handle to adjust the internal valve mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main cylindrical body of the faucet made of stainless steel, connecting the switch and spout.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal valve system and connects the water supply to the spout.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural base for the faucet.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is a curved tubular part made of stainless steel, extending outward from the frame.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the faucet to the sink.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally to direct water flow to different areas of the sink.
